mapper.update: UPDATE internal_message SET type = #{type}, sender = #{sender}, receiver = #{receiver}, subject = #{subject}, content = #{content}, channel = #{channel}, state = #{state}, org_id = #{orgId}, business_id = #{businessId}, priority = #{priority}, is_read = #{isRead}, create_time = #{createTime}, read_time = #{readTime}, create_by = #{createBy}, update_by = #{updateBy}, is_deleted = #{deleted}, update_time = #{updateTime} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.delete: UPDATE internal_message SET is_deleted = TRUE WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT id, type, sender, receiver, subject, content, channel, state, org_id as orgId, business_id as businessId, priority, is_read as isRead, create_time as createTime, read_time as readTime, create_by as createBy, update_by as updateBy, is_deleted as deleted, update_time as updateTime FROM internal_message WHERE id = #{id} AND is_deleted = FALSE
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM internal_message WHERE receiver = #{userId} AND org_id = #{orgId} AND is_read = FALSE AND is_deleted = FALSE

SELECT id as accessoryId, resource_type as resourceType, resource_id as resourceId, resource_name as resourceName, resource_icon as resourceIcon, resource_code as resourceCode, resource_desc as resourceDesc, amount, state FROM message_accessory WHERE message_id = #{messageId} ORDER BY id ASC
